name: Cassowary Local HTTP Load Tester
free_limit: MIT-licensed local HTTP/S load-testing CLI for Windows, macOS and Linux with concurrent requests, duration settings, POST payloads and metrics export; no software quota or expiry.
watch_out: Runs on your own computer or infrastructure; no free hosted load generators or cloud compute are included. Prometheus, CloudWatch and target infrastructure may incur separate costs. Run load tests only against systems you are authorized to test.
